Based on Amazon's FY2024 10-K, net sales were $513,983M (FY2022), $574,785M (FY2023), and $637,959M (FY2024) [DOC: amzn_growth.txt].

Year-over-year growth:
- FY2023 vs FY2022: ~11.8%
- FY2024 vs FY2023: ~11.0%

This represents a slight deceleration (roughly 0.8 percentage points lower), though the rate stayed in a similar broad range (~11%), so it could also be characterized as roughly flat with a modest slowdown.

ANSWER: Decelerated slightly — YoY revenue growth slowed from ~11.8% in FY2023 to ~11.0% in FY2024.
